dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: IAEA/UN and major-wire review found no newly released 1 August verified inspection-access breakthrough, 90% enrichment finding, weapon test, NPT withdrawal, or nuclear-material movement. Iran nuclear-test markets remain low while NPT-withdrawal pricing remains materially higher; verification opacity keeps the tracker critical

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: CNBC and AP reported that a tanker was hit by gunfire about 11 nautical miles northeast of Oman early 1 August; another tanker reported an explosion at sea. Both continued and crews were safe. Iran's president also repeated a threat to close Hormuz if attacks continue. This is a confirmed ceasefire violation in an already-capped theater, not evidence that the strait is fully closed

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Lebanese leaders condemned Israeli explosions and demolitions in southern Lebanon reported on 31 July. The Hezbollah-disarmament framework remains contested and strike risk stays at the ceiling, but the 15Z review found no distinct post-cutoff nuclear or direct-alliance escalation

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Major-wire and regional review found no new state-on-state strike, large mobilization, or nuclear signaling in the past 24 hours. Deterrence remains intact despite background friction

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Major-wire, UN, and regional review found no new verified cross-border state strike or strategic-force movement in the past 24 hours; the post-ceasefire environment remains fragile but below a fresh threshold

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Kyiv authorities raised the overnight Russian ballistic-missile and drone strike toll to at least nine killed and more than two dozen wounded. Separately, Ukraine confirmed sinking the sanctioned Russian container ship Yanina near Novorossiysk; Rosatom said all 17 crew survived and no nuclear cargo was indicated. Extreme conventional war risk persists, but no verified nuclear-use or direct-NATO-entry threshold was crossed

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: NATO and major-wire review found no verified Article 5 invocation or new direct NATO-Russia combat in the scan window. Allied support for Ukraine remains firm, but current Kyiv and Black Sea attacks did not cross the configured direct-alliance threshold

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Official and major-wire review found no new nuclear test, confirmed ICBM launch, invasion movement, or allied force redeployment in the past 24 hours

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
